title: Releases, cadena de suministro y attestations

checks.description: release-please-config.json declara un único paquete en la raíz de tipo simple, con tags sin componente, y .release-please-manifest.json existe
checks.cmd: jq -r '"type=" + .packages["."]["release-type"] + " component=" + (.["include-component-in-tag"] | tostring) + " packages=" + (.packages | length | tostring)' release-please-config.json && jq -e 'has(".")' .release-please-manifest.json >/dev/null

checks.description: release.yml corre en push a main y su job release-please usa release-please-action fijada por SHA con el config y el manifest
El job release-please escribe solo en contents, pull-requests e issues
El job images de release.yml necesita a release-please y solo corre si se creó una release
El job images publica api y web con la versión de la release como tag
release.yml instala Trivy y syft como binario de su release comprobado con sha256sum, sin trivy-action ni la versión comprometida 0.69.4
checks.cmd: f=.github/workflows/release.yml; printf 'checksum=%s trivy-action=%s bad=%s trivy=%s syft=%s' "$(grep -c 'sha256sum -c' $f)" "$(grep -c 'trivy-action' $f)" "$(grep -c '0\.69\.4' $f)" "$(yq '.jobs.images.env.TRIVY_VERSION' $f)" "$(yq '.jobs.images.env.SYFT_VERSION' $f)"

checks.description: Un step de images escanea la imagen publicada por digest con Trivy y falla con --exit-code 1
checks.cmd: yq '[.jobs.images.steps[] | select((.run // "" | test("trivy image .*--exit-code 1")) and (.env.REF // "" | test("steps\.build\.outputs\.digest")))] | length' .github/workflows/release.yml

checks.description: El job images firma dos attestations con actions/attest fijada por SHA sobre el digest publicado: procedencia y SBOM, las dos guardadas en el registro
checks.cmd: yq '.jobs.images.steps[] | select(.uses // "" | test("^actions/attest@[0-9a-f]{40}$")) | "sbom=" + (.with | has("sbom-path") | tostring) + ":" + (.with."subject-digest" | test("steps\.build\.outputs\.digest") | tostring) + ":" + (.with."push-to-registry" | tostring)' .github/workflows/release.yml | sort | tr '\n' ' '

checks.description: El job images pide id-token, attestations, artifact-metadata y packages en escritura y contents en lectura, nada más
Todas las imágenes externas de api/Dockerfile y web/Dockerfile (FROM y COPY --from) van fijadas por tag y digest
Las imágenes de services de los workflows de tablero van fijadas por tag y digest
dependabot.yml vigila el ecosistema docker en /api y /web con cooldown
checks.cmd: yq '.updates[] | select(."package-ecosystem" == "docker") | (.directories // [.directory] | sort | join(",")) + " cooldown=" + (.cooldown."default-days" // 0 | tostring)' .github/dependabot.yml

checks.description: dependency-review.yml envía el snapshot de syft a la API de dependency submission desde un job con contents: write
checks.cmd: yq '.jobs[] | select([.steps[]?.run // ""] | join(" ") | test("syft scan .*github-json")) | select([.steps[]?.run // ""] | join(" ") | test("dependency-graph/snapshots")) | "contents=" + .permissions.contents' .github/workflows/dependency-review.yml

checks.description: En los PR a main, dependency-review-action fijada por SHA falla con avisos de gravedad high o superior, desde un job de solo lectura
checks.cmd: yq '"pr=" + (.on.pull_request.branches | join(",")) + " " + (.jobs[] | select([.steps[]?.uses // ""] | join(" ") | test("actions/dependency-review-action@[0-9a-f]{40}")) | "contents=" + .permissions.contents + " severity=" + (.steps[] | select(.uses // "" | test("dependency-review-action")) | .with."fail-on-severity"))' .github/workflows/dependency-review.yml

checks.description: Solo escriben codeql, deploy-gate, images, labeler, nightly, pr-report, release (release-please e images) y dependency-review (snapshot); ningún write-all ni read-all
checks.cmd: grep -rlE 'permissions: *(write|read)-all' .github/workflows; yq -N '.jobs | to_entries | .[] | .value.permissions // {} | to_entries | .[] | select(.value == "write") | (filename | sub(".*/"; "")) + ":" + .key' .github/workflows/*.yml | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '
checks.assert: stdout~^codeql.yml:security-events dependency-review.yml:contents deploy-gate.yml:id-token images.yml:packages labeler.yml:pull-requests nightly.yml:actions pr-report.yml:pull-requests release.yml:artifact-metadata release.yml:attestations release.yml:contents release.yml:id-token release.yml:issues release.yml:packages release.yml:pull-requests $

checks.description: actionlint y zizmor pasan sin hallazgos sobre los workflows de tablero
tablero tiene una release vX.Y.Z publicada por release-please y release.yml está en verde en el último commit de main
checks.cmd: git fetch -q origin main && sha=$(git rev-parse origin/main) && printf 'tag=%s release=%s' "$(gh release view --json tagName --jq .tagName)" "$(gh run list --workflow release.yml --commit "$sha" --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion')"

checks.description: gh attestation verify acepta la procedencia y el SBOM de tablero-api en la última versión, firmados por release.yml de tablero
checks.cmd: owner=${GH_REPO%%/*}; v=$(gh release view --json tagName --jq .tagName); img="oci://ghcr.io/${owner,,}/tablero-api:${v#v}"; for p in https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1 https://spdx.dev/Document/v2.3; do gh attestation verify "$img" --repo "$GH_REPO" --signer-workflow "$GH_REPO/.github/workflows/release.yml" --predicate-type "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf 'ok ' || printf 'mal '; done
